method: Equity market capitalization / September book; GAAP quarterly margins. No EV subtraction of financial funding debt, no annualization of a quarter.
limitations: UPST concentrates in personal/unsecured lending and reports fair-value loan changes. AFRM point-of-sale/card loans use amortized-cost CECL for HFI and merchant/network revenue. Upstart HFS loan investment sits in CFO whereas much Affirm HFI sits in investing. No comparable cash-conversion ratio or acquisition-adjusted target multiple is asserted.
